name: @tech-matters/e2e-test-runner
description: Lambda for running Playwright E2E tests

scripts.docker:run: docker run -it --rm --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:exec -e DEBUG=pw:browser -e AWS_DEFAULT_REGION -e AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY -e AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID -e LOAD_SSM_CONFIG=true -e HL_ENV=development -e HL=e2e -e TEST_IN_LAMBDA=true -e AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT=900 -p 9000:8080 e2etestrunner

author: Tech Matters
